## Language and screen/context

Which language did you change, and where does the text appear?

## What changed and why?

Please mention important grammar decisions, alternatives, or terminology changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Only one target language changed
- [ ] English reference strings, keys, comments, placeholders and plural categories are unchanged
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/validate_translations.py`, or I need help running it
- [ ] No personal data, screenshots with private information, or source code included
- [ ] I've read the [CC0 contribution terms](../LICENSING.md) and can submit this translation

**Proofreading:** Is this reviewed by a native/competent speaker? If so, which parts? (A green CI check alone is not human review.)

**Optional credit:** If I include you in CONTRIBUTORS.md, what public name or handle would you prefer? You can also say "no public credit".
